query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN 1 END) as y2025,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN 1 END) as y2024,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN research_domain = 'chimie_olfactive' THEN 1 END) as chimie,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN research_domain = 'botanique' THEN 1 END) as botanique,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN research_domain = 'histoire_parfumerie' THEN 1 END) as histoire
FROM bibliography_entries;
